feed.title: Awesome DSH Plugin — Curated DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Plugin List

entry.title: lak321/dsh-filetree
entry.summary: Project file browser: per-session file tabs, a directory tree, and a VSCode-style editor (C syntax highlighting, line numbers, auto-indent, status bar) that follows the current workspace.

entry.title: xiaoyanzi191/dsh-premium-themes
entry.summary: 8 curated color schemes plus custom palette import (name + scheme + seed colors derive a full token map), a Palette row in General settings, hot-plug install.

entry.title: futongxu9-maker/dsh-msgrail
entry.summary: Message-index rail at the conversation's right edge: one brand-colored dot per user message, hover to preview, click to jump, auto-loads older history; pure plugin with no host patching.

entry.title: bowenliang123/dsh-context
entry.summary: Context insight panel: see what the model's context window is made of and how it evolves — composition vs. window size, per-request history, compression/injection events, and per-message token stats.

entry.title: futongxu9-maker/dsh-shared-memory
entry.summary: Cross-conversation shared memory: MEMORY.md + USER.md injected into every session's system prompt, with a memory tool and a GUI panel (Hermes-style).

entry.title: Anlushu/hkinsure
entry.summary: Hong Kong insurance data MCP: 260+ real products, 17 insurers, dividend fulfillment rates. Query/compare/calculate for any AI tool (Hermes / dsh / Claude Code).

entry.title: gongyijie85/dsh-repo-setup
entry.summary: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db hints and recommends skill plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files (claude-code-setup counterpart).

entry.title: gloryxpnv/dsh-tool-vision
entry.summary: Local-first vision for the text-only DeepSeek Harness: a local VLM (LM Studio / Ollama / vLLM) produces structured JSON evidence (OCR / layout / semantics) at zero API cost, with image data never leaving the machine.

entry.title: futongxu9-maker/dsh-path-reveal
entry.summary: Click any absolute Windows path in DSH messages to reveal it in Explorer (select the file or open the folder).

entry.title: yangyunsong023/dsh-sxs-anti-bot-http
entry.summary: Anti-bot HTTP fetch tools hardened by SXS's production scraping stack (millions of requests/day): UA-pool rotation, retry with exponential backoff, anti-bot wall detection (captcha / verification challenges) and adaptive rate limiting — tools: `sxs_fetch` / `sxs_fetch_json` / `sxs_rate_status`.

entry.title: yangyunsong023/dsh-sxs-news-collector
entry.summary: Trending-topics collector aggregating Baidu / Toutiao / Douyin / Weibo hot lists in one call (Weibo optional cookie), returning titles with heat values for content creators — tool: `sxs_news_hot`.

entry.title: cdxiaodong/dsh-llm-inspector
entry.summary: Unified LLM request/response inspector: reasoning-effort tuning, external-think export, traffic & bundle analysis.

entry.title: gongyijie85/dsh-ponytail
entry.summary: Ponytail, lazy senior dev mode, for DSH: 6 skills (ponytail, ponytail-audit, ponytail-debt, ponytail-gain, ponytail-help, ponytail-review) adapted from DietrichGebert/ponytail (MIT).

entry.title: gongyijie85/mattpocock-skills-dsh
entry.summary: Matt Pocock's full promoted skill set (25 SKILL.md files: grilling, writing-for-agents, wait-what, TDD, code-review, wayfinder, ask-matt router and more) as a DeepSeek Harness plugin, adapted from mattpocock/skills (MIT).

entry.title: gongyijie85/mattpocock-skills-dsh-zh
entry.summary: Matt Pocock's skills in Chinese for DSH: all 25 SKILL.md translated to natural Chinese (technical terms kept in English with glosses), adapted from mattpocock/skills (MIT).

entry.title: 940842546/dsh-permissions
entry.summary: Claude Code-style permission rules engine: hard/deny/ask/allow tiers with a hard tier above full access, workspace-scoped rules, wildcard path protection, and a visual staged editor; rules persist in settings.yaml.

entry.title: Andyqwe44/dsh-notify-win
entry.summary: Native Windows toast + taskbar flash for task done / approval / ask_user_question, Win10/11, npm install `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-notify-win`.

entry.title: cdxiaodong/dsh-island
entry.summary: Bridge DSH agent sessions, tool calls, and approvals to the CodeIsland macOS notch panel over a Unix socket, with in-panel allow/deny.

entry.title: cdxiaodong/dsh-guardian
entry.summary: Agent security guardrail: intercepts and audits every tool call, requiring human confirmation on sensitive operations.

entry.title: JAdpp/dsh-whale-galgame
entry.summary: Multi-character Galgame conversation view with separate character and reply-model selection, per-character affection, memory, dialogue history, and CG galleries, plus responses informed by task events across Harness sessions.

entry.title: pk7j7sqryy-ops/dsh-token-pet
entry.summary: Cute token-usage widget in the session header: context occupancy, session usage and breakdown, plus date/weekday, weather, 3-day forecast and severe-weather alerts.

entry.title: lancecheney/dsh-deepseek-balance
entry.summary: A real-time billing badge left of the Session log button: balance, per-conversation spend, peak/off-peak/flat pricing, auto-switching by model/currency/effort, daily official pricing fetch.

entry.title: BeiZi6/dsh-opencodego-usage
entry.summary: OpenCodeGo quota monitor for the DSH Web GUI: a breathing indicator at the input's bottom-right (green/yellow/red by remaining share), a liquid-glass panel with rolling/weekly/monthly usage windows and reset times, auto-refreshing every 30 s; API key read from DSH credentials.

entry.title: Lanxing6480/dsh-galgame
entry.summary: A visual-novel presentation layer for the DSH Web chat view: portrait diffs, streaming thought bubble, typewriter dialogue, and GalGame-style question/approval panels; switch back to the normal chat anytime.

entry.title: BeiZi6/dsh-theme-plugin
entry.summary: Theme studio for the DSH Web GUI: five built-in presets plus fully customizable light/dark palettes (accent, background, foreground, UI and code fonts, translucent sidebar, contrast), hot-swapped instantly and persisted in localStorage.

entry.title: zhtx2024/dsh-skin-switcher
entry.summary: Adds a Skins page to Settings that auto-discovers installed skins for one-click switching, with one-click restore to the official default look.

entry.title: flyingtimes/dsh-trajectory-reader
entry.summary: Trajectory interpretation tab: summarizes each user round — what was wanted and how the assistant fulfilled it (needs/thinking/execution/results) via a rules engine plus optional LLM narrative; files, commands and errors at a glance; user messages stay verbatim.

entry.title: Gumiho12345/dsh-plugin-net-access
entry.summary: Net Access permission mode: keeps workspace-write protection while making curl.exe HTTPS work inside the sandbox (Windows).

entry.title: xiehuan123/coding-coach
entry.summary: Coding Coach: a 35-skill bundle plus a full agent preset for non-developers (8-stage product→launch pipeline with engineering/product/UI skills), installable via npm (`dsh plugin add coding-coach`) and as a Claude Code plugin.

entry.title: xiehuan123/dsh-deepread
entry.summary: DeepRead: deep-reading assistant with four modes (incl. a claim-evidence-data-relations knowledge map with four confidence levels), WeChat article links / local .pdf (built-in pure-JS extractor) / pasted text, and optional MD / FreeMind / styled HTML export.
